shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and torso
frontal or profile face with prominent nose/beak
decorative circular/disc motifs on the surface
justification: Both depict a single large anthropomorphic being with a prominent projecting facial feature and surface decoration including roundels/discs, but A is a detailed profile winged figure striding through a field of rosettes, holding objects in each hand, while B is a frontal, blocky bust-like figure with schematic incised markings (circles, arcs, a belt-like band) and no wings, attributes or narrative action. The correspondence amounts to little more than 'a humanoid figure with some circular motifs', which any two unrelated traditions could produce independently.
